<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs. Do not edit; source: internal/cli/main.go. Run task docs:ref:gen. -->

Every command of the `goal` CLI, in the order its usage text lists them: each section shows the command's forms, what it does and its flags. `goal` without a valid command prints the same text and exits 2.

## Conventions

&lt;item&gt; is goal#2 (factory and number), the item's id, or a bare number such as 2 when one factory has that item (--factory F picks the factory of a bare number). &lt;factory&gt; is a name or an id. --move S=T sends the open items of station S, which the new version drops, to station T.

Factory definitions live in goald (drafts and published versions), not in files: goal factory push is how a folder changes one, and goald ignores factory files written to the bucket.

Every command that talks to goald (run, follow, item, note, answer, move, pause, cancel, the decisions, deny, status, andon, factory, policy, standing-rules, connection, credential, knowledge, search, runs, eval, bake-off, jonah, spend, judge, triggers, webhooks) acts in one organization: --org &lt;slug|id&gt;, else GOAL\_ORG, else org in the config file ($XDG\_CONFIG\_HOME/goal/config.json, default ~/.config/goal/config.json; goal org use writes it), else the install's only organization (decisions are the local user's); with GOAL\_API\_KEY set, or a key or personal token stored by goal login --token, commands act in its own organization

With sign-in on (GOAL\_AUTH=session), commands send GOAL\_API\_KEY (an API key goal\_sk\_… or a personal token goal\_pat\_…) when it is set, else what goal login stored for goald's origin, and only over https or to this machine; a refused credential or permission exits 77

## goal up

```text
goal up [--compose]
```

start PostgreSQL and RustFS, prepare the database roles, migrate the database, prepare the bucket, start the egress proxy, run goald (and, with sign-in, Mailpit and the auth service); --compose runs goald and the auth service as compose services too, and returns once they are healthy

Flags: `--compose`.

## goal run

```text
goal run <factory> "<brief>" [--type T] [--body B] [--priority N] [--detach]
```

submit a work item and follow it until a human or done (--type: one of the factory's work types; default its first, none when it declares none)

Flags: `--type T`, `--body B`, `--priority N`, `--detach`.

## goal follow

```text
goal follow <item>
```

follow an item's events again

## goal item

```text
goal item <item>
```

show an item with its outputs as JSON, and its human touches (who acted, where, planned or not, why) on stderr

## goal approve

```text
goal approve <item> [--always-allow]
```

approve an item waiting at a human station, or the tool call its agent waits on; --always-allow also lets that agent role call that tool without asking from now on (a standing rule; needs connection:manage)

Flags: `--always-allow`.

## goal deny

```text
goal deny <item> [--note "..."]
```

deny the tool call the item's agent waits on; its next run's brief carries the denial and the note

Flags: `--note "..."`.

## goal reject

```text
goal reject <item> --reason "..."
```

send it back for rework

Flags: `--reason "..."`.

## goal retry

```text
goal retry <item>
```

send a blocked item back to its station's queue

## goal merge

```text
goal merge <item>
```

merge the item's pull request, then approve it (at a station with action: merge)

## goal note

```text
goal note <item> "<text>"
```

leave a note for the agents: the item's next run reads it

## goal answer

```text
goal answer <item> "<text>" | --choice <n>
```

answer the question the item's agent asked, in your words or by its choice's number (from 1)

Flags: `--choice <n>`.

## goal move

```text
goal move <item> <station> [--reason "..."]
```

put the item at another station (a reason is needed upstream, where it counts as rework); a run in progress is stopped

Flags: `--reason "..."`.

## goal lane

```text
goal lane <item> <lane>
```

set the lane of an open item that is not in progress: it picks the agent where a station routes by lane

## goal pause

```text
goal pause <item> [--reason "..."]
```

stop the item where it is (goal retry resumes it); a run in progress is stopped

Flags: `--reason "..."`.

## goal cancel

```text
goal cancel <item> [--reason "..."]
```

close the item for good where it is; its pull request stays open

Flags: `--reason "..."`.

## goal status

```text
goal status [--factory F] [--window 7d]
```

per factory over the last days (1d to 90d): work in progress, items done, lead time p85, human touches per finished item, the touchless share and the station with the most unplanned touches; without --factory, every factory and the organization's total

Flags: `--factory F`, `--window 7d`.

## goal andon

```text
goal andon <factory>
```

whether the line runs, its gates' rework tallies and the recent andon pulls

## goal andon pull

```text
goal andon pull <factory> --reason "..."
```

pull the andon cord: the line releases and claims nothing until it is cleared

Flags: `--reason "..."`.

## goal andon clear

```text
goal andon clear <factory> [--note "..."]
```

clear it: the line runs again

Flags: `--note "..."`.

## goal factory pull

```text
goal factory pull <factory> <dir> [--version N|current|draft]
```

write a version's files (default: the current one) into a new folder, with .goal/pulled.json

Flags: `--version N|current|draft`.

## goal factory validate

```text
goal factory validate <dir>... [--offline]
```

validate folders through goald (--offline: schema and references only, without goald; goal validate is goal factory validate --offline, same flags)

Flags: `--offline`.

## goal factory push

```text
goal factory push <dir> [--publish [--message M]] [--replace-draft] [--force] [--move S=T]...
```

make the folder the factory's draft (creating the factory if its metadata.id is new); --publish then publishes it. Refused when an open draft has changes the folder was not pulled from (--replace-draft archives it) or a version was published after the pull (--force pushes over it)

Flags: `--publish`, `--message M`, `--replace-draft`, `--force`, `--move S=T`.

## goal factory publish

```text
goal factory publish <factory> [--message M] [--move S=T]...
```

validate and publish the open draft

Flags: `--message M`, `--move S=T`.

## goal factory list

```text
goal factory list [--validate] [--archived]
```

the factories: current version, open draft, paused (--archived: only the archived ones)

Flags: `--validate`, `--archived`.

## goal factory versions

```text
goal factory versions <factory>
```

the published versions (\* the one that runs)

## goal factory restore

```text
goal factory restore <factory> <N> [--move S=T]...
goal factory restore <factory>
```

run version N again

list an archived factory again; it stays paused

Flags: `--move S=T`.

## goal factory archive

```text
goal factory archive <factory>
```

retire a paused factory none of whose items is being worked; it keeps its history and leaves the list

## goal factory delete

```text
goal factory delete <factory> [--yes]
```

delete an archived factory for good, with its items, runs and versions, after typing its name (--yes: no prompt); a factory never published needs no archive

Flags: `--yes`.

## goal factory ask

```text
goal factory ask <factory> "<text>" [--agent A] [--wait]
```

ask goald to change the factory's draft (a draft request, about agent A with --agent); it never publishes. --wait waits until it is done or failed and prints what it changed

Flags: `--agent A`, `--wait`.

## goal org list

```text
goal org list
```

the organizations (\* the one commands act in)

## goal org use

```text
goal org use <slug>
```

act in this organization from now on (config file)

## goal org create

```text
goal org create <slug> --name N [--mark M]
```

create an organization (platform admins only)

Flags: `--name N`, `--mark M`.

## goal org update

```text
goal org update <slug> [--name N] [--slug S] [--mark M] [--max-slots N]
```

rename it, or cap the agents running at once across its factories (--max-slots 0: no cap)

Flags: `--name N`, `--slug S`, `--mark M`, `--max-slots N`.

## goal org delete

```text
goal org delete <slug> [--yes]
```

delete it after typing its name (--yes: no prompt); it is purged after GOAL\_ORG\_RETENTION

Flags: `--yes`.

## goal policy get

```text
goal policy get
```

the organization's policy: allowed models and the default, denied commands, tool defaults, box time limit; who uses each model and box size, and the egress addresses

## goal policy set

```text
goal policy set [--models M,M] [--default M] [--deny-command P]... [--box-limit 3h]
```

change what the flags name (owners and admins), keeping the rest as read; refused when the policy changed since it was read (--deny-command replaces the list)

Flags: `--models M,M`, `--default M`, `--deny-command P`, `--box-limit 3h`.

## goal standing-rules list

```text
goal standing-rules list [--revoked] [--json]
```

the organization's standing rules: which agent role may call which connection tool without asking, who made it and when (--revoked: the revoked ones too)

Flags: `--revoked`, `--json`.

## goal standing-rules revoke

```text
goal standing-rules revoke <rule>
```

revoke one: the agent asks first again for that tool

## goal key list

```text
goal key list
```

the organization's API keys: hint, scopes, factories, ceiling, expiry, last use

## goal key create

```text
goal key create <name> --scope S [--scope S]... [--factory F]... [--role viewer|approver|editor] [--expires 90d]
```

create an API key for scripts and CI (scopes: permissions such as org:read, factory:read, item:create; --role is the most it acts as on a factory, default viewer; --expires 1d to 90d, default 90d). The secret is printed once, alone on stdout: store it as GOAL\_API\_KEY

Flags: `--scope S`, `--factory F`, `--role viewer|approver|editor`, `--expires 90d`.

## goal key revoke

```text
goal key revoke <name|id>
```

revoke a key: anything using it stops working at once

## goal connection list

```text
goal connection list [--kind K] [--factory F]
```

the organization's connections: kind, status, which secrets are set (never a value), what uses them

Flags: `--kind K`, `--factory F`.

## goal connection show

```text
goal connection show <name>
```

one connection: its fields, last test, the env names a run gets and its kind's docs

## goal connection create

```text
goal connection create <name> --kind K [--field k=v]... [--secret k=-] [--secret-file k=<path>]... [--description D]
```

create a connection (owners and admins); a secret comes from stdin (k=-, one value) or a file, never argv

Flags: `--kind K`, `--field k=v`, `--secret k=-`, `--secret-file k=<path>`, `--description D`.

## goal connection update

```text
goal connection update <name> [--name N] [--description D] [--field k=v]... [--secret k=-] [--secret-file k=<path>]...
```

rename it, change its fields (merged; k= clears one) or replace the named secrets

Flags: `--name N`, `--description D`, `--field k=v`, `--secret k=-`, `--secret-file k=<path>`.

## goal connection delete

```text
goal connection delete <name>
```

delete it (refused while a factory's current version names it)

## goal connection test

```text
goal connection test <name>
```

run its kind's test from goald (exit 1 when it fails)

## goal connection kinds

```text
goal connection kinds
```

the kinds connections are made of, the platform's and the organization's

## goal connection kind push

```text
goal connection kind push <file.yaml>
```

create or replace an organization kind from its file

## goal connection kind delete

```text
goal connection kind delete <name>
```

delete an organization kind no connection is of

## goal credential list

```text
goal credential list
```

the organization's credentials: type, factories, what uses them, last use and expiry (never a value)

## goal credential create

```text
goal credential create <name> --type T [--description D] [--factory <id>]... [--all-factories] [--expires YYYY-MM-DD] [--remind-days N]
```

create a credential (owners and admins; types api\_key, oauth\_token, ssh\_key, cloud\_role, app\_key); its value comes from stdin, never argv: ... &lt; value-file

Flags: `--type T`, `--description D`, `--factory <id>`, `--all-factories`, `--expires YYYY-MM-DD`, `--remind-days N`.

## goal credential replace

```text
goal credential replace <name>
```

replace its value with the one on stdin

## goal credential rm

```text
goal credential rm <name>
```

delete it (refused while a connection refers to it as {{name}}; the error names them)

## goal credential import

```text
goal credential import <file> [--format env|yaml] [--on-conflict replace|skip] [--dry-run]
```

import a .env or YAML file's credentials (format from the extension by default; a name that exists is skipped unless --on-conflict replace); prints each name as new or exists (--dry-run) or what was done with it

Flags: `--format env|yaml`, `--on-conflict replace|skip`, `--dry-run`.

## goal knowledge sources

```text
goal knowledge sources [--factory F]
```

the knowledge base's sources: kind, status, documents, last and next sync, the factories that search them

Flags: `--factory F`.

## goal knowledge add

```text
goal knowledge add <name> --kind upload|synced|live [--connection C] [--config k=v]... [--title T] [--every 1h]
```

add a source (owners and admins); a synced or live one reads a connection, --config says what (space=ENG)

Flags: `--kind upload|synced|live`, `--connection C`, `--config k=v`, `--title T`, `--every 1h`.

## goal knowledge sync

```text
goal knowledge sync <source>
```

sync it now

## goal knowledge upload

```text
goal knowledge upload <source> <file>...
```

upload text, Markdown, HTML, JSON or YAML files to an upload source; indexed at its next sync

## goal knowledge documents

```text
goal knowledge documents <source>
```

its documents: id, title, status, size

## goal knowledge rm

```text
goal knowledge rm <document>
```

delete an uploaded document

## goal knowledge search

```text
goal knowledge search "<query>" [--source S]... [--limit N]
```

search as agents do: the best passages first, with their document ids or links

Flags: `--source S`, `--limit N`.

## goal knowledge usage

```text
goal knowledge usage [--source S] [--days N] [--json]
```

each document's use over the window (default 7 days, at most 90), of S or every source: runs, helped and misled, the people's share in brackets

Flags: `--source S`, `--days N`, `--json`.

## goal knowledge uses

```text
goal knowledge uses <document> [--json]
```

the runs that used it, newest first: item, factory, search or read, first use

Flags: `--json`.

## goal knowledge verdict

```text
goal knowledge verdict <document> helped|misled [--run R] [--note TEXT] [--json]
```

give your verdict on it, of a run that used it with --run

Flags: `--run R`, `--note TEXT`, `--json`.

## goal search

```text
goal search "<query>" [--limit N] [--json]
```

search the organization's items, agents, factories and connections, by group, best first (--limit: per group, 1 to 20, default 5; --json: goald's answer as it came)

Flags: `--limit N`, `--json`.

## goal runs

```text
goal runs [--factory F] [--status S] [--since T] [--until T] [--search Q] [--limit N] [--cursor C] [--json]
```

the organization's agent runs, newest first: factory, item, station, agent, model, start, duration, turns, cost and status, then the window's totals and spend (--since/--until: RFC 3339, default the current UTC day; --status: running, succeeded, failed or cancelled; --search: item title, agent, model or #147; another page prints its --cursor)

Flags: `--factory F`, `--status S`, `--since T`, `--until T`, `--search Q`, `--limit N`, `--cursor C`, `--json`.

## goal eval run

```text
goal eval run [--case C] [--draft] [--factory F] [--json]
```

start an eval run of the factory's eval cases (every one, or --case), on the current version or --draft, and print what it is about to cost

Flags: `--case C`, `--draft`, `--factory F`, `--json`.

## goal eval show

```text
goal eval show <run> [--factory F] [--json]
```

an eval run's state and cost, and each case's tries: pass, fail or error

Flags: `--factory F`, `--json`.

## goal jonah

```text
goal jonah [--factory F] [--state S]
```

Jonah's proposals of definition changes, newest first: number, title, state and the files they change (--state: proposed, published, applied, rejected or superseded)

Flags: `--factory F`, `--state S`.

## goal jonah show

```text
goal jonah show <number> [--factory F]
```

a proposal's evidence and a unified diff of each file

Flags: `--factory F`.

## goal jonah approve

```text
goal jonah approve <number> [--factory F]
```

publish the proposal as a new version, as you

Flags: `--factory F`.

## goal jonah edit

```text
goal jonah edit <number> [--factory F]
```

write its files into the draft, to continue in the builder

Flags: `--factory F`.

## goal jonah reject

```text
goal jonah reject <number> --reason "..." [--factory F]
```

reject it; later reviews read the reason

Flags: `--reason "..."`, `--factory F`.

## goal jonah look

```text
goal jonah look [--factory F]
```

queue a review of the factory's sent-back runs now

Flags: `--factory F`.

## goal bake-off run

```text
goal bake-off run <agent> [--model M]... [--trials N] [--follow] [--factory F] [--json]
```

print the estimate and the models, then start a bake-off of the agent's eval cases on 2 to 4 models (default its model and goald's default ones; --trials: tries per case, default 3); --follow waits for the result

Flags: `--model M`, `--trials N`, `--follow`, `--factory F`, `--json`.

## goal bake-off show

```text
goal bake-off show <id> [--factory F] [--json]
```

the recommended model against the current one, then per model the pass rate, cost and time per item, turns and judged share (Recommended, Now), and per case the tries passed per model

Flags: `--factory F`, `--json`.

## goal bake-off apply

```text
goal bake-off apply <id> [--model M] [--factory F] [--json]
```

write the recommended model (or M) as the agent's model into the factory's draft; nothing is published

Flags: `--model M`, `--factory F`, `--json`.

## goal spend

```text
goal spend [--window week|month|90d] [--json]
```

what the organization's agent runs cost (default this week), per merged item and on rework, and each factory's budget: running, stopped or over\_budget, its spend today and in the last 7 days

Flags: `--window week|month|90d`, `--json`.

## goal judge list

```text
goal judge list [--factory F] [--json]
```

the factory's judges (default: the organization's only factory): enabled, sample, pass mark, and over the last 30 days the pass rate, runs scored and cost; then what its judge runs cost (--json: goald's answer as it came)

Flags: `--factory F`, `--json`.

## goal judge try

```text
goal judge try <slug> [--factory F] [--json]
```

queue the judge on the 10 newest finished runs of its agents; the tries never count in its 30-day figures

Flags: `--factory F`, `--json`.

## goal triggers list

```text
goal triggers list <factory> [--json]
```

the factory's triggers in definition order: on or off, when they fire, what they create, the items they created in the last 7 days, and why one may not be creating items (triggers change in the definition)

Flags: `--json`.

## goal triggers show

```text
goal triggers show <factory> <trigger> [--json]
```

a trigger, what its items did in the last 7 days and its recent events: created, merged or skipped

Flags: `--json`.

## goal triggers try

```text
goal triggers try <factory> <trigger> --event ID [--json]
```

dry-run the trigger on one of its 20 newest events (ID from goal triggers show): whether it matched, each step and why, the item it would create; nothing is created, but the model check runs and its cost is spent

Flags: `--event ID`, `--json`.

## goal webhooks list

```text
goal webhooks list <factory> [--json]
```

the factory's webhook endpoints: kind, address, the triggers they feed, deliveries in 7 days (never a secret)

Flags: `--json`.

## goal webhooks create

```text
goal webhooks create <factory> <name> [--kind generic|github] [--json]
```

add an endpoint (default kind generic); its signing secret is printed once, alone on stdout: store it in the sender now

Flags: `--kind generic|github`, `--json`.

## goal webhooks rotate

```text
goal webhooks rotate <factory> <name> [--json]
```

replace its signing secret, printed once the same way; the old one stops working at once

Flags: `--json`.

## goal webhooks deliveries

```text
goal webhooks deliveries <factory> <name> [--limit N] [--after C] [--json]
```

what it received, newest first: refused (and why), accepted or created an item

Flags: `--limit N`, `--after C`, `--json`.

## goal connection import-env

```text
goal connection import-env
```

once, after the cutover to connections: GOAL\_GITHUB\_TOKEN becomes github, CLAUDE\_CODE\_OAUTH\_TOKEN (or ANTHROPIC\_API\_KEY) claude; names that exist are left as they are

## goal storage init

```text

```

## goal catalog skills list

```text

```

the catalog's skills: key, commit, installs

```text

```

add a template version (&lt;dir&gt;/template.yaml and the definition in &lt;dir&gt;/factory/; NAME defaults to the folder's name) to the bucket's template catalog

## goal catalog templates list

```text
goal catalog templates list
```

the catalog's templates, latest version of each

## goal db init

```text

```

create the database roles goald runs as (goal\_owner, goal\_app) and hand the schema to goal\_owner

## goal db migrate

```text

```


## goal admin list

```text

```

the platform admins (platform admins only)

## goal admin add

```text

```


## goal login

```text
goal login [--store keychain|file]
goal login --token [--store keychain|file]
```

sign the CLI in: approve the code it shows at &lt;goald&gt;/device in a browser; the session goes to the OS keychain, or with --store file (remembered) to credentials.json beside the config file (mode 0600)

Flags: `--store keychain|file`, `--token`.

## goal logout

```text

```

Flags: `--all`.

## goal whoami

```text

```
